title: 국군의무사령부령 / queue:ADDENDUM:28266:20170905:00007:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA (Enforcement Decree of the Military Personnel Management Act) <No. 28266, September 5, 2017>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted>

Articles 2 and 3 Omitted.

Article 4 (Amendment of Other Statutes and Regulations) (1) through (15) Omitted.

(16) The Decree on the Armed Forces Medical Command is partially amended as follows:

In Article 2 (2), "ministerial-level officers" shall be replaced with "general-grade officers (將星級)", and "ministerial-level officers or" shall be replaced with "general-grade officers or".

(17) through (90) Omitted.
